lines.text: 有同学只能用键盘，有人家中网络不稳。他们不是不愿意学，只是进不去。
公平不一定是人人使用同一方式。以共同学习目标设计不同途径，并让受影响的学生参与测试。
新的 AI 对话练习很受欢迎，但只有语音输入，还要倒数作答。
The new AI conversation practice is popular, but it only takes voice input and has a countdown.
One learner uses a keyboard, and another has an unreliable connection at home. They want to learn. The design is blocking them.
Fairness does not always mean using the same route. Design varied routes to a shared learning goal, and involve affected learners in testing.
流畅不等于忠实。翻译须照顾语境、读者及作者声音；按任务要求清楚交代 AI 协助。
这是我们感谢校工的展板。AI 的英文很顺，但把“饮水思源”改成了成功口号。
同学说直接用就好。可是这样展出的，还是我们想说的话吗？
This display thanks our school support staff. The AI’s English is smooth, but it turned “飲水思源” into a success slogan.
Fluency is not faithfulness. Translation needs context, audience and author voice, with AI assistance explained according to the task’s requirements.
Someone said we should just use it. But would the display still say what we mean?
把姓名删掉就安全吗？这个工具会保留多久，我完全不知道。
我只想请 AI 帮忙改英文。上传前才发现，作文写了同学家里的事。
先减少资料，再查核工具。只分享学习所需的内容，并让学生理解安排及保有选择。
Minimise data first, then check the tool. Share only what learning requires, and help students understand the arrangements and retain a choice.
I only wanted AI feedback on the English. Before uploading, I noticed the essay describes a classmate’s family situation.
Is removing the name enough? I have no idea how long this tool keeps our writing.

Ask more than whether an AI answer is correct. Who was overlooked? Which data is unnecessary? Can the people affected challenge a decision?
Stars record exploration, not moral rank. Resolve the four cases, then try the new situation in your notebook. Support your next action with a specific piece of evidence.
可是队友都听懂了我的论点。我需要改善的，到底是表达，还是口音？
同学，你看这张反馈单。AI 说我的英语不够好，理由竟然是“不像母语者”！
先问“衡量什么”，再看分数。AI 反馈要对准学习目标，并容许人类复核及提出异议。
But my teammates understood my argument. Am I meant to improve my communication, or change my accent?
Ask what is being measured before trusting a score. Align AI feedback with learning goals, and provide human review and a way to challenge it.
Hey, look at this feedback. The AI says my English is weak because I do not sound like a native speaker!
